# Erebor Banking API

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
- For a complete documentation index, see https://docs.erebor.bank/llms.txt
- For section-specific indexes, append `/llms.txt` to any section URL
- For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.erebor.bank/_mcp/server
